text.p: Australian oil and gas producer Santos Ltd was rated a "buy" reflecting the group's quality of earnings and growth potential, Wilson HTM Ltd resources analyst, John Webby said in a report.
"Based on the quality of earnings, reliable franked dividend and earnings growth over the next two years, we recommend Santos as a buy," Webby said
He said Santos was favoured because of its national gas market coverage, oil production, long-term gas contracts and a growing reserves base.
Webby forecast that Santos net profits would rise to A$190.2 million for the year ended December 31, 1997 and to A$234.5 million in 1998.
These forecasts compared with an actual A$181.9 million reported for the 1996 calendar year.
"The growth in forecast earnings is based on continued strong gas sales following the first year of production from East Spar and from Cooper Basin sales to the Brisbane market," Webby said.
The strong gas sales were combined with forecast growth in oil production from 1998, Webby said.
